chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said in another hadith:
If he had consummated the marriage with her, then she is entitled to the full dowry.

key_terms.الصَّدَاقُ: the dowry due to the wife in marriage

ai.seo_question: When is a woman entitled to receive the full dowry in marriage according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the woman's financial entitlement in marriage. It states that if consummation took place, then the woman is owed the full dowry.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5672 - And Imam (as) said in another narration:
"If he had consummated the marriage with her, then she is entitled to the full dowry (ṣadaq)."
